qualification: local pinned-fixture userspace and workload evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

fixture.commandLine: console=ttyS0 earlycon=uart,io,0x3f8,115200 panic=-1 rdinit=/init plus a unique runner-owned dory.pvh_run_id

diagnosis.symptom: After memory-CMOV admission, a one-billion-instruction tier-one run emitted zero console bytes, delivered zero interrupts, and remained in the delay-loop calibration fallback with PIT, HPET, and the local APIC timer disabled.
diagnosis.control: The same fixture and legacy-baseline setting completed all seven workloads and powered off, isolating the regression to tier-one admission.
diagnosis.narrowing: Temporarily declining every tier-one binary statement restored normal boot; allowing any individual ADD, SUB, CMP, or TEST family reproduced a fatal or stalled run.
diagnosis.rootCause: A tier-one block could publish a deferred arithmetic-flags descriptor and chain directly into a legacy baseline or optimizing resident. Legacy code reads only the materialized RFLAGS context word, so its flag consumers observed the stale pre-producer image.
diagnosis.repair: The executor now materializes a pending descriptor before every tier-one-to-legacy transition, collects the materialization count before rollback checkpoints, and records only compilation-tier-homogeneous native traces. All temporary diagnostic admission controls were removed before the source commit.

verification.mixedTierDifferential: A tier-one ADD produces carry and chains into a legacy memory ADC; the result and complete architectural state match the interpreter, with exactly one transition materialization.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,428 tests in 171 suites passed; one pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent

comparison.note: This is one recovery run per setting and demonstrates correctness plus directional performance only; it is not a statistical benchmark. The control predates the transition repair, which is unreachable while tier-one admission is disabled.

interpretation: The repaired production tier-one path now crosses the original calibration failure, reaches authenticated userspace, passes every requested workload, and shuts down through ACPI. The legacy baseline remains required because 146,777 of 241,414 tier-one attempts declined during the successful run.
limitations: The recovery and legacy comparison each contain one local full run on one Apple M2 Pro; no confidence interval or cross-host conclusion is claimed.
The diagnostic runner explicitly marks these records releaseQualified=false; this receipt does not satisfy the later G1-G5 qualification gates.
Raw diagnostic and narrowing runs remain in an ignored local build directory and are not release evidence.
Successful userspace does not close A05.2 while the legacy baseline is still required for declined blocks.
